paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for four different methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL)”, ranges from 2.5 to 10.0 in linear scale, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU”, ranges from 26 to 34 in linear scale, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The “Consistency-CE” method is represented by a magenta dashed line with circular markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 26.1 at AL=2.5 and rising to about 31.2 at AL=10.0. The “Inconsistency-CE” method is shown as a dark purple dashed line with square markers, beginning at approximately 26.2 at AL=2.5 and increasing to about 31.0 at AL=10.0. The “Inconsistency-CE-MP” method is depicted by a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 26.9 at AL=2.5 and rising to about 32.1 at AL=10.0. The “Consistency-Bi” method is represented by a red solid line with star markers, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 30.4 at AL=2.5 and increasing to about 33.0 at AL=10.0. All lines show an overall increasing trend as AL increases.
